title: 第8章 搭便车，开房-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    凌晨两点的影视城跟鬼屋似的。

    韩小汐推着自行车快哭了都。

    她还没来得及消化三千块的巨款和稳定的日收，就乐极生悲——

    自行车链条掉了。

    怎么都卡不上。

    室外接近零下十度的气温，直接给她一整晚的亢奋急速降温。

    诡异的红墙深巷，晦暗不明的路灯。

    韩小汐真的要崩溃了！

    好想打车逃离这里。

    偏偏连个出租车影子都看不到……

    而且，这个点，她能去哪儿？！

    早过了学校门禁时间……

    漫无目的的走着，双脚冻得已经快失去知觉。

    韩小汐强迫自己尽量不去看周围的环境，专注脚下。

    突然，脚下一个不知道什么小动物一窜而过。

    神经紧绷到极点的韩小汐，彻底崩溃。

    哐当——

    她猛地扔了自行车拔腿就跑。

    直到跑得气喘吁吁……

    终于身后有车灯亮起。

    两台商务车。

    韩小汐想都没想，拦在了马路中间。

    不管是谁，能把她带离这个鬼地方就行！

    一个急刹，商务车刹停。

    原本闭目养神的沈珩睁开了眼睛，“怎么了？”他问。

    “老板，前面有个女生拦车。”副驾的郭炜回头汇报，“这个点了，不可能还有疯狂粉丝吧？！”天太黑，他并没有认出韩小汐。

    “等杰睿处理。”沈珩继续闭眼。

    果然，后车上，朱杰睿下了车，有些不耐烦的跑到前面。他身后，斯蒂芬也跟着屁颠屁颠的来凑热闹。

    “我去！小可怜？！你这是怎么了？眼泪鼻涕的！”斯蒂芬一脸诧异。

    韩小汐看到来人，连忙胡乱用袖子擦了擦脸。

    “能拜托载我一段，把我带到前面大学城吗？”

    车上，郭炜看到几人在交谈，也认出了人。

    急忙汇报，“老板，是韩小姐！”

    沈珩再次睁开眼。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The film and television city at two o'clock in the morning looks like a haunted house.

Han Xiaoxi almost cried while pushing the bicycle.

Before she had time to digest the huge sum of three thousand yuan and the stable daily income, she felt extremely happy and sad——

The bicycle chain fell off.

Can’t get stuck no matter what.

The temperature outside was close to minus ten degrees, which quickly cooled down her excitement all night long.

Weird alleys with red walls and dim street lights.

Han Xiaoxi is really going to collapse!

I really want to take a taxi and escape from here.

Not even a taxi can be seen...

And, at this point, where can she go?!

It’s already past the school gate hours...

Walking aimlessly, my feet were so cold that I almost lost consciousness.

Han Xiaoxi forced herself not to look at her surroundings and focus on her feet.

Suddenly, an unknown small animal scurried past under my feet.

Han Xiaoxi, whose nerves were extremely tense, completely collapsed.

——

She threw her bicycle away and ran away.

Until I am out of breath from running...

Finally, a car light came on behind me.

Two commercial vehicles.

Han Xiaoxi stopped in the middle of the road without even thinking.

No matter who it is, just take her away from this hellish place!

With a sudden brake, the business car stopped.

Shen Heng, who had closed his eyes to rest, opened his eyes, "What's wrong?" he asked.

“Boss, there’s a girl blocking the car in front of me.” Guo Wei, the co-driver, turned around and reported, “At this hour, there can’t be crazy fans, right?!” It was too dark, so he didn’t recognize Han Xiaoxi.

"Wait for Jerry to deal with it." Shen Heng continued to close his eyes.

Sure enough, in the car behind, Zhu Jierui got out of the car and ran to the front impatiently.Behind him, Stephen also joined in the fun.

"I'll go! Poor thing?! What's wrong with you? You're full of tears and runny nose!" Stephen looked surprised.

When Han Xiaoxi saw the person coming, she quickly wiped her face with her sleeves.

“Can you please give me a ride and take me to the university town ahead?”

In the car, Guo Wei saw several people talking and recognized them.

He hurriedly reported, “Boss, it’s Miss Han!”

Shen Heng opened his eyes again.
